local_notes: Use the white standard bag. Houses put bags out in front of the gate; apartments use the complex collection point. Collection days depend on your area (Mon/Wed/Fri or Sun/Tue/Thu zone).
method_en: Put general waste in the white district standard bag and place it in front of your house on your area's collection day.
applies_to: Two zones: Mon/Wed/Fri and Sun/Tue/Thu (dong list not published on the page)
notes_ko: 배출시간 '지정된 시간(20:00~24:00)', 단독주택은 '지정된 생활폐기물 수거일'에 배출. 2026 설 연휴 안내(https://www.guro.go.kr/newyear2026/html/sub4.html)에 '월수금 배출지역'/'일화목 배출지역' 2개 권역이 존재함을 확인했으나 동별 권역 목록은 공식 페이지에서 찾지 못함. 청소행정과(02-860-2899)에 동별 권역 확인 필요.

local_notes: Use the yellow food waste bag. Houses and small restaurants put it in front of the house or shop on the area's designated day; apartments use the complex container or RFID bin. Put-out time is 19:00~24:00 in winter and 20:00~24:00 in summer.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a yellow food waste bag and set it out in front of your home on your area's designated day.
applies_to: Designated days by area (dong list not published on the page)
notes_ko: 단독주택·소형음식점: '지역별 지정된 요일', '동절기 19시~24시, 하절기 20시~24시', '내집 앞 또는 점포 앞에 봉투째 배출'. 공동주택은 단지 자체 지정시간·전용수거용기(RFID). 계절별 시간이 달라 time 칸은 비움. 지역별 요일 목록은 미게재.

local_notes: Recyclables must not go in standard bags; sort them separately. The district page does not list recyclable collection days or times.
method_en: Sort recyclables by material and put them out separately from general waste.
notes_ko: 공식 페이지에서 재활용 배출 요일·시간을 찾지 못함(재활용 메뉴 key=2696은 '콘텐츠 준비중'). '재활용품은 종량제 봉투 제외' 정도만 확인. day/time 비움 — 청소행정과 확인 필요. 일반쓰레기와 같은 권역 요일일 가능성 있으나 미확인.

local_notes: Report bulky items online, via the 'Ppaegi' (빼기) app or at your community service center, pay the fee, then put the item out for collection on the designated date. Recyclable items may be collected free by the Guro Recycling Center (02-858-8272).
method_en: Apply and pay the bulky waste fee first, then put the item out on the scheduled collection date.
notes_ko: 신고→접수→접수증 발급→수거 4단계. 온라인/빼기 앱/주민센터 방문 신청, 수수료 결제 후 배출. 배출 시간·장소는 페이지에 명시 없음. 환불 문의 청소행정과 860-2945.

local_notes: Put bags in front of your own house or shop, not on the sidewalk or by street trees. No put-out on the day before a public holiday or the last Friday of each month. Shops on main roads such as Siheung-daero: 22:00~01:00.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: 매일수거제: '토요일을 제외한 요일 18:00 ~ 24:00'. 공휴일 전날 배출금지, 공휴일 18시부터 배출. 페이지 제목은 '매월 마지막 토요일', 세부항목은 '매월 마지막 금요일 배출 금지'로 표기가 엇갈림 — 확인 필요. 시흥대로 등 주요도로 상가 22:00~01:00.

local_notes: Houses use a food waste bag inside a dedicated container; free 25L containers are available at community service centers. Apartments use the RFID bin with a household card. No put-out on Saturday, the day before a public holiday, or the day before the last Saturday of the month.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag inside the container and place it in front of your house.
notes_ko: '일요일~금요일 18시~24시'. 배출금지: 매월 마지막 토요일 전날(2026.1.1.부터), 공휴일 전날, 토요일 당일. 공동주택 RFID(비닐 투입금지).

day: Sun~Wed, Fri (vinyl and clear PET: Thu only)
local_notes: Vinyl and clear PET bottles go out only on Thursday; other recyclables Sun~Wed and Fri. Houses use clear or see-through bags in front of the house; recyclables in black bags are not collected.
method_en: Sort recyclables by type into clear bags and place them in front of your house on the right day.
notes_ko: '폐비닐·투명페트병 : 목요일', '기타 재활용품목 : 일~수, 금요일'. 배출시간 18~24시. 목요일에 비닐·페트 외 품목은 미수거될 수 있음. 검은 봉투 미수거.

local_notes: Report online or by phone (community service center or the Sanitation Division) before putting the item out. The district collects bulky waste directly, 07:00~15:00.
method_en: Report the item and pay the fee before putting it out in front of your house.
notes_ko: '인터넷 배출신고 또는 전화접수신고(동주민센터, 청소행정과) 후 배출', 구 직영 수거 07:00~15:00(수거시간이므로 배출시간 칸은 비움). 문의 청소행정과 02-2627-1472. 수수료 금액은 미확인.

local_notes: Put bags in front of your house or shop, or at a designated spot such as an apartment collection point or Clean House. No put-out on Saturdays or during national holiday periods. Fines up to KRW 1,000,000 for violations.
method_en: Use the district standard bag, tie it closed and place it in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: '종량제 규격봉투에 담아 20:00~24:00에 배출 (단 토요일, 명절연휴기간은 배출하지 않습니다)'. 요일을 별도 지정하지 않아 '토요일 제외 매일'로 정리.

local_notes: Use a food waste bag in the designated food waste container near your home, or the RFID bin with a card where installed. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag and place it in the designated container.
notes_ko: 일반가정: '오후 8시 ~ 자정', '공휴일 전날 및 토요일 제외'. 종량제 봉투 100원/L, RFID 지역은 카드 사용. 소형점포는 납부필증(140원/L).

day: Every day except Sat and public holidays
local_notes: Put recyclables in front of your house or shop, or at a Clean House or recycling station. Vinyl goes in a clear or semi-transparent bag. No put-out on Saturdays or public holidays.
method_en: Clean and sort recyclables by material and place them in front of your house or at the recycling station.
notes_ko: '배출시간: 20:00 ~24:00 사이 배출(토요일, 공휴일 배출 금지)'. 품목별 요일제(비닐/페트)는 페이지에 없음.

local_notes: Buy a bulky waste sticker (stamp note) at your community service center or on the district website and attach it to each item. Large appliances are collected free via 1599-0903.
method_en: Buy a bulky waste sticker, attach it to the item and put it out as instructed.
notes_ko: 영문 공식 페이지: 동주민센터 또는 구청 홈페이지에서 스티커 구입 후 부착. 배출 시간 미명시. 온라인 신청은 스마트클린 영등포(smartclean.ydp.go.kr) — 미열람. 국문 대형폐기물 안내 페이지(reserve key=4176)는 404.

local_notes: Put bags in front of your house. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday. Bedding, unusable clothes and stuffed toys need a special bag or bulky waste disposal.
method_en: Use the district standard bag, tie the top and place it in front of your house.
notes_ko: '17:00 ~ 22:00까지, 토요일 및 공휴일 전날 제외(쓰레기 · 음식물쓰레기 · 재활용가능 폐기물 동시배출)', '내 집앞(문전 배출)'. 동별 차이는 대행업체만 다름.

local_notes: Separate food waste, drain it and put it out in the dedicated bag or container in front of your house at the same time as general waste. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in the dedicated bag or container and place it in front of your house.
notes_ko: 일반쓰레기·음식물·재활용 동시배출 규정 적용. 음식물 전용 페이지는 별도 확인 안 함.

day: Every day except Sat (vinyl, clear PET, small appliances, batteries: Thu and Sun only)
local_notes: Vinyl, clear PET bottles, small appliances and batteries go out only on Thursday and Sunday. Put recyclables in a plastic bag or tie them with string in front of your house.
method_en: Sort recyclables by type, bag or tie them, and place them in front of your house.
notes_ko: '비닐·투명페트병·소형가전·배터리류는 목,일요일만 배출'. 기타 재활용은 토요일·공휴일 전날 제외 매일.

local_notes: Apply online (Smart Clean Dongjak) or by phone to the collection contractor 2~3 days before, pay the fee, and write the disposal number on the item. Place it in front of your house (apartments: designated spot).
method_en: Apply and pay online or by phone, write the disposal number on the item and put it out in front of your house.
notes_ko: '온라인(인터넷) 신청 또는 대행업체에 전화 신청(배출 2~3일 전)', '배출번호 기재 후 배출', '내 집 앞(공동주택은 내부 지정장소)'. 당일 신청은 당일 수거 불가.

local_notes: Put bags at the designated spot in front of your house or shop. Street-front areas: 22:00~01:00. Do not put waste out during the day, on non-collection days, or while it is raining or snowing.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: 배출시간 토요일 제외, '주거지역 : 18:00부터 24:00까지', 가로지역 22:00~익일 01:00, '내 집앞, 내 점포 앞 지정장소'. 동별로 대행업체만 다름.

local_notes: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag inside a dedicated container. Small restaurants attach a fee sticker. Mixing food waste into general waste can be fined up to KRW 200,000.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag and place it in the dedicated container.
notes_ko: 음식물 배출 방법만 확인('최대한 수분 제거 후 음식물 전용봉투에 넣어 전용용기에 담아 배출'). 음식물 배출 요일·시간은 공식 페이지에 미기재 — 비움. 문의 02-879-6221.

day: Every day except Sat (vinyl and clear PET: Thu only)
local_notes: Vinyl and clear PET bottles are sorted separately and go out only on Thursday. Use clear or semi-transparent bags in front of your house or shop. Apartments follow the complex's own rules.
method_en: Sort recyclables into clear bags and place them in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: 단독·다가구·다세대·연립·상가 토요일 제외 매일, ''21.12.25.부터 폐비닐과 투명페트병은 각각 분리하여 목요일에만 배출'. 주거지역 18~24시, 가로변 22~01시. 공동주택은 관리사무소 문의.

local_notes: Apply online at Smart Clean Gwanak or by phone (02-882-5677) and pay the fee before disposal. Put the item in front of your house or shop.
method_en: Apply and pay first, then put the item in front of your house in the evening.
notes_ko: 인터넷/전화(02-882-5677) 배출신청. 배출요일 '일·월·화·수·목·금', 시간 '저녁 6시~12시 사이', 장소 '내 집 · 내 점포 앞'. 수수료 금액은 별도 메뉴.

local_notes: General waste goes out every other day on your area's days (Sun/Tue/Thu or Mon/Wed/Fri). Put it in front of your house or shop; roadside buildings and shops 22:00~01:00. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your house on your area's collection days.
applies_to: Two zones by dong: Sun/Tue/Thu or Mon/Wed/Fri
notes_ko: '배출시간 : 18:00~익일 01:00(공휴일 전날 및 토요일은 배출금지)', '일반·재활용쓰레기 : 격일제'. 일반쓰레기 요일: 일·화·목 지역: 방배본·1동, 반포2·3동, 서초2·4동, 양재1동(우면동), 반포본동, 방배2동, 서초3동(반포대로 동편-남부터미널 방면), 내곡동·염곡동·신원동. 월·수·금 지역: 잠원동, 방배4동, 반포4동(반포대로 서편-서래마을 방면), 서초1동, 방배3동, 양재2동(원지동), 반포1동, 반포4동(반포대로 동편-미도아파트 방면), 서초3동(반포대로 서편-서울고 방면).

local_notes: Food waste can go out every day for households and small restaurants. Drain it and use the food waste bin or a volume-based food waste bag. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday.
method_en: Drain the food waste and put it in the food waste bin or bag in front of your house.
notes_ko: '음식물쓰레기 : 매일(가정, 소형음식점 등)'. 토요일·공휴일 전날 배출금지 적용. 영문 페이지(https://www.seocho.go.kr/site/fe/04/10413000000002020090709.jsp)도 'Food waste can go out every day'.

local_notes: Vinyl and clear PET bottles go out only on their own day (Thu or Fri depending on area); other recyclables (paper, cans, bottles, plastic) on the area's other two days. Mixed put-out is not collected.
method_en: Sort recyclables by type into clear bags and put them out on your area's recycling days.
applies_to: Two zones by dong: vinyl/PET Thu + others Sun/Tue, or vinyl/PET Fri + others Mon/Wed
notes_ko: 일·화·목 지역: 폐비닐·투명페트병 목 / 기타 재활용 일·화. 월·수·금 지역: 폐비닐·투명페트병 금 / 기타 재활용 월·수. '비닐·투명페트병은 별도 배출요일에만 배출, 다른 재활용품과 함께 배출한 경우 수거유예'. 동 구분: 일·화·목 지역: 방배본·1동, 반포2·3동, 서초2·4동, 양재1동(우면동), 반포본동, 방배2동, 서초3동(반포대로 동편-남부터미널 방면), 내곡동·염곡동·신원동. 월·수·금 지역: 잠원동, 방배4동, 반포4동(반포대로 서편-서래마을 방면), 서초1동, 방배3동, 양재2동(원지동), 반포1동, 반포4동(반포대로 동편-미도아파트 방면), 서초3동(반포대로 서편-서울고 방면).

local_notes: Request bulky waste pickup by phone or online on the district website and pay the fee. Large appliances are collected free (1599-0903); houses put small appliances out on recycling day.
method_en: Request pickup by phone or online and pay the fee before putting the item out.
notes_ko: 대형폐기물 일반: '전화 및 온라인 접수 (구청 홈페이지 참고)', 수수료 부담. 대형가전 무상방문수거(1599-0903), 소형가전 무상(일반주택은 재활용 배출일). 배출 시간 미기재. 문의 청소행정과 02-2155-6720.

local_notes: Put bags in front of your own house or shop. No put-out on Saturdays. Broken glass, cat litter and similar items go in special non-burnable PP bags.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: '배출시간 : 20:00 ~ 익일 05:00', '배출장소 : 내 집 앞, 내 점포 앞', 이미지 대체텍스트 '일반종량제와 음식물쓰레기는 일~금요일 배출 가능, 토요일 배출 불가'(2021 게시). 단, '쓰레기 배출 안내'(board/waste/6, 2020)는 '월요일~금요일, 오후 8시~다음날 오전 5시'로 표기 — 일요일 포함 여부 확인 필요.

local_notes: Drain food waste and put it in a food waste bag inside the food waste collection container. No put-out on Saturdays. Animal bones, shells and eggshells go in the general waste bag.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag and place it in the collection container.
notes_ko: 요일·시간은 이미지 대체텍스트(일반·음식물 일~금, 토 불가) 및 배출시간 20:00~익일 05:00 기준. 배출방법은 '쓰레기 배출 안내'(board/waste/6) 참조.

day: Sun~Wed, Fri (vinyl and clear PET: Thu only)
local_notes: Thursday is only for vinyl and clear PET bottles; other recyclables go out Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed and Fri. No recyclables on Saturday. Vinyl goes in a clear bag.
method_en: Sort recyclables by material and place them in front of your house on the right day.
notes_ko: '일반재활용은 일·월·화·수·금요일 배출 가능, 목·토요일 배출 불가', 목요일 비닐·투명페트병만. 목록 페이지의 '비닐·투명페트병 별도 분리배출 요일제'(#bbs8)도 같은 내용. 시간은 공통 배출시간 적용.

local_notes: Apply at least 3 days before, by phone to the collection contractor or online on the district website, and pay the fee. Houses put the item in front of the house; apartments at the complex collection point. No collection on Sundays and public holidays.
method_en: Apply at least 3 days ahead, pay the fee and put the item out at the agreed spot.
notes_ko: '배출 3일전 대행업체에 직접 전화신청 또는 강남구청 온라인신청', 수거일 월~토(일·공휴일 제외). 2017 게시물이라 최신성 확인 필요. 배출 시간 미기재.

local_notes: Houses put general waste out after sunset in front of the gate on their area's days (Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Sun). Apartments are collected daily. Putting waste out during the day can be fined.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your gate after sunset on your area's days.
applies_to: Houses: Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Sun by dong; apartments daily

local_notes: Houses put food waste in a food waste bag inside the shared container in front of the gate on their area's days, or use an RFID bin. Apartments use the RFID bin. Putting food waste in a general bag can be fined up to KRW 200,000.
method_en: Drain the food waste, put it in a food waste bag and place it in the container in front of your gate.
applies_to: Houses: same days as general waste (Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Sun by dong); apartments daily
notes_ko: 일반주택 '배출일시 지정요일 18시~22시(쓰레기배출안내 참조)', '내 집 대문 앞'. 요일은 key=3153 표의 '일반·음식물' 행 기준 — 월·수·금 지역(일반·음식물 월·수·금 / 기타재활용 월·수 / 폐비닐·폐페트병 금): 마천2동, 오금동, 송파1동, 가락2동, 풍납1·2동, 삼전동, 송파2동, 위례동. 화·목·일 지역(일반·음식물 화·목·일 / 기타재활용 화·일 / 폐비닐·폐페트병 목): 거여1동, 마천1동, 오륜동, 방이2동, 석촌동, 가락본동, 문정1동, 장지동 일부, 거여2동, 잠실본동, 방이1동. 아파트 등 매일수거(재활용 제외) 표기 지역: 오륜동, 가락1동, 문정2동(문정도시개발지구), 잠실2·3·4·6·7동, 위례동, 가락시장1구역, 장지파인타운, 동남권유통단지.

local_notes: Houses: other recyclables go out on two days (Mon/Wed or Tue/Sun) and vinyl/PET on one day (Fri or Thu) depending on the area. Use clear plastic bags. Apartments follow their own recycling days.
method_en: Sort recyclables into clear bags and put them out in front of your gate on your area's days.
applies_to: Houses by dong: others Mon/Wed + vinyl/PET Fri, or others Tue/Sun + vinyl/PET Thu
notes_ko: 재활용품 투명비닐봉투 배출(쓰레기 처리체계 key=3155). 시간 수치 미기재(해가 진 후). 월·수·금 지역(일반·음식물 월·수·금 / 기타재활용 월·수 / 폐비닐·폐페트병 금): 마천2동, 오금동, 송파1동, 가락2동, 풍납1·2동, 삼전동, 송파2동, 위례동. 화·목·일 지역(일반·음식물 화·목·일 / 기타재활용 화·일 / 폐비닐·폐페트병 목): 거여1동, 마천1동, 오륜동, 방이2동, 석촌동, 가락본동, 문정1동, 장지동 일부, 거여2동, 잠실본동, 방이1동. 아파트 등 매일수거(재활용 제외) 표기 지역: 오륜동, 가락1동, 문정2동(문정도시개발지구), 잠실2·3·4·6·7동, 위례동, 가락시장1구역, 장지파인타운, 동남권유통단지.

local_notes: Report online (district website or 'Ppaegi' app) and pay by card or bank transfer, or call your dong's collection contractor on weekdays 09:00~18:00. Mark the item and put it in front of your gate; collection is the next day or later.
method_en: Report and pay the fee first, then put the item in front of your gate with the report number attached.
notes_ko: 인터넷(구청 홈페이지, 빼기 앱/웹) 신고 후 카드·계좌이체 결제, 또는 동별 대행업체 전화(평일 09:00-18:00) 후 계좌이체. '대문 앞에 배출', '익일 이후 수거'. 토·일·공휴일 전화 신고 불가. 대형가전 무상수거 1599-0903.

local_notes: Put bags in front of your house or shop or at a designated collection point. No put-out on Saturdays or the day before a public holiday. Ceramics, broken glass and bricks need a special bag.
method_en: Use the district standard bag and place it in front of your house or shop.
notes_ko: '쓰레기 배출은 매일 (단, 공휴일 전날, 토요일 제외) 밤 8:00 ~ 새벽 4:00'. 동별로 대행업체(5개 권역)만 다르고 요일 차이는 명시 없음.

local_notes: Put food waste in a food waste bag, use a fee sticker, or use an RFID bin. Shells, pits, bones and eggshells go in general waste.
method_en: Drain the food waste and put it out in a food waste bag or the RFID bin.
notes_ko: '음식물 종량제봉투, 납부필증, RFID 종량기에 배출'. 음식물 전용 요일·시간은 페이지에 별도 기재 없음 — 공통 '매일(공휴일 전날·토 제외) 20:00~04:00'이 적용될 가능성이 높으나 미확인이라 비움.

day: Every day except Sat (vinyl and clear PET: Thu only)
local_notes: Vinyl and clear PET bottles go out only on Thursday, and no other recyclables on Thursday. Cans, bottles and plastics go in clear bags; paper and styrofoam are tied with string.
method_en: Sort recyclables into clear bags or bundles and place them in front of your house.
notes_ko: '※ 폐비닐·투명 폐페트병 배출일: 목요일(기타 재활용 배출 금지)'. 재활용 시간은 별도 기재 없음(공통 20:00~04:00 적용 추정, 미확인이라 비움). day는 공통 배출일(토·공휴일 전날 제외 매일) 기준.

local_notes: Apply online at least 2 days before the collection date and pay the fee. Contact: 02-472-1003.
method_en: Apply online at least 2 days ahead, pay the fee and put the item out on the collection date.
notes_ko: 수거일 2일 전까지 온라인 신청, 수수료는 '수집/운반 수수료' 메뉴 참조(미열람). 문의 02-472-1003(천일에너지). 배출 시간·장소 미기재.
